sequence.description: 소속 커머디티 스톡 내 해당 옵션선택의 순번. 옵션그룹 순번에 대응.

IShoppingCartCommodityStockChoice.description:
장바구니 아이템 내 개별 스톡-옵션선택 정보를 담는 엔티티 타입.

shopping_cart_commodity_stock_choices 테이블 구조(옵션 레퍼런스, 후보ID/value, 시퀀스 등)와 1:1 매칭. 상품유닛 옵션 선택, 커머디티 구성 변경, DB검증 로직에 활용됩니다.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the delivery journey. Corresponds to the primary key of the 'shopping_delivery_journeys' table in the database.

Used for system references, auditing, and ensures the journey record's uniqueness per delivery event. For example, this ID is used when updating, deleting, or associating journey records in related workflows.

shopping_delivery_id.description:
Reference to the parent delivery record ('shopping_deliveries.id').

Links the journey step to the specific delivery process it belongs to. A delivery may have multiple associated journey steps representing phases such as preparation, shipping, and completion.

type.description:
Phase type or stage in the delivery process. Examples include 'preparing', 'manufacturing', 'shipping', 'delivering'.

Defines the logical state in the delivery workflow; values are typically drawn from a controlled list mandated by system requirements. Enables precise traceability of status throughout the logistics chain.

oneOf.description:
Optional title for this journey step, providing a human-readable summary or description.

Useful for display in logistics dashboards or to clarify custom workflow steps.

title.description:
Optional title for this journey step, providing a human-readable summary or description.

Useful for display in logistics dashboards or to clarify custom workflow steps.

oneOf.description:
Optional further explanation or notes about the journey step.

May contain free-text explanations, special instructions, or operator remarks for each phase of the delivery process.

description.description:
Optional further explanation or notes about the journey step.

May contain free-text explanations, special instructions, or operator remarks for each phase of the delivery process.

sequence.description:
Sequence or order of this journey step within a delivery.

Numeric value enables the system to sort and present multiple journey records in logical chronological or business-defined order.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this journey record was created.

Serves as the main audit field for tracking journey initialization or workflow progression. Reflects the record's creation in the system, not necessarily the real-world event.

oneOf.description:
Optional timestamp when this journey step actually started.

Enables precise tracking of logistics or production flows—important for SLAs and BI analysis.

started_at.description:
Optional timestamp when this journey step actually started.

Enables precise tracking of logistics or production flows—important for SLAs and BI analysis.

oneOf.description:
Optional timestamp when this journey step was completed.

Combined with 'started_at', supports lead-time and delay analytics, as well as customer-facing delivery status screens.

completed_at.description:
Optional timestamp when this journey step was completed.

Combined with 'started_at', supports lead-time and delay analytics, as well as customer-facing delivery status screens.

oneOf.description:
Marks the record as deleted/void without removing it from the database (soft delete). 

Integral for audit/evidence retention in the shopping mall's compliance workflow; enables record recovery or inspection post-deletion.

deleted_at.description:
Marks the record as deleted/void without removing it from the database (soft delete). 

Integral for audit/evidence retention in the shopping mall's compliance workflow; enables record recovery or inspection post-deletion.

IShoppingDeliveryJourney.description:
Represents a single step (or phase) in the delivery process for a shopping mall order shipment, according to the 'shopping_delivery_journeys' Prisma schema. Each delivery consists of one or more journey records sequenced to mirror the package's path through the fulfillment pipeline (e.g., preparation, shipping, delivery completion).

Each journey captures audit fields, phase/type, and metadata. This supports analytics, SLA compliance, logistics optimization, and dispute resolution. Key journey types and their transitions are critical for timeline accuracy, customer notifications, and legal evidence.

shopping_delivery_id.description:
Required. Reference to the delivery record to which this journey belongs. Must match an existing 'shopping_deliveries' record.

Ensures correct linkage between a journey step and its delivery context.

type.description:
Required. Type or phase of journey step (e.g., 'preparing', 'manufacturing', 'shipping', 'delivering'). See requirements for permitted values.

Supported values and business logic may vary by system customization and should be enforced at the application or API layer.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Short title for this delivery journey phase.

Useful for labeling workflow steps for display or BO dashboards.

title.description:
Optional. Short title for this delivery journey phase.

Useful for labeling workflow steps for display or BO dashboards.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Human-readable explanation or notes for the journey entry.

Allows operators to specify additional details at each phase.

description.description:
Optional. Human-readable explanation or notes for the journey entry.

Allows operators to specify additional details at each phase.

sequence.description:
Required. Position of this journey step within the delivery's journey sequence.

Ensures correct business ordering of delivery phases. Sequencing must avoid duplicates per delivery.

oneOf.description:
Optional. If journey starts immediately upon creation, this field can be pre-filled (for corner-cases or backfilling prior records).

Represents the actual start time of the phase, not just when the model was created.

started_at.description:
Optional. If journey starts immediately upon creation, this field can be pre-filled (for corner-cases or backfilling prior records).

Represents the actual start time of the phase, not just when the model was created.

oneOf.description:
Optional. If the journey step is already completed at creation (data migration, rapid progression), include the actual completion timestamp here.

Application logic determines if this state can be applied at creation or must be left null.

completed_at.description:
Optional. If the journey step is already completed at creation (data migration, rapid progression), include the actual completion timestamp here.

Application logic determines if this state can be applied at creation or must be left null.

IShoppingDeliveryJourney.ICreate.description:
Input type for registering a new delivery journey record in the mall system, following the 'shopping_delivery_journeys' Prisma model. Used for POST operations where a logistics phase, such as 'shipping' or 'preparation', is registered for traceability.

Captures both minimal required fields (journey type/phase, sequence, delivery reference), and optional audit/time fields if relevant (e.g. for migration, pre-filled status, or batch backfill). Does not require an explicit ID—the system will generate it.

type.description:
Optionally update the journey phase/type, if business rules permit.

Used to correct misclassification or reflect workflow changes (e.g., business process retriage).

oneOf.description: Optional. Update or set a new short title for this delivery journey phase.

title.description: Optional. Update or set a new short title for this delivery journey phase.

oneOf.description: Optional. Edit or provide new notes about the journey step.

description.description: Optional. Edit or provide new notes about the journey step.

sequence.description: Optional. Change the phase's sequence/order in the delivery journey. Must preserve unique sequence per delivery.

oneOf.description: Optional. Update or set the journey phase's actual start time.

started_at.description: Optional. Update or set the journey phase's actual start time.

oneOf.description: Optional. Update or set the phase's actual completion time.

completed_at.description: Optional. Update or set the phase's actual completion time.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Set if the record is being (logically) deleted at this moment (for soft delete tracking).

Should only be set by backend, admin, or system API, not from normal user flows.

deleted_at.description:
Optional. Set if the record is being (logically) deleted at this moment (for soft delete tracking).

Should only be set by backend, admin, or system API, not from normal user flows.

IShoppingDeliveryJourney.IUpdate.description:
Update type for an existing delivery journey step in the mall system, mapping to 'shopping_delivery_journeys' update operations. Accepts all fields that may be changed (phase, title, audit fields) except for immutable references (ID, parent delivery).

Supports patch/update for sequence correction, workflow edits, or reclassification. Business logic determines which transitions are permitted in practice (cannot undelete, may not move to certain phases without preconditions, etc.).

oneOf.description:
Optional. Search or filter coupons by their display name (supports partial matches in admin GUIs).

Used for fetching all coupons with a similar name, e.g., for analytics, mass edits, or statistics.

name.description:
Optional. Search or filter coupons by their display name (supports partial matches in admin GUIs).

Used for fetching all coupons with a similar name, e.g., for analytics, mass edits, or statistics.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Filter by accessLevel—'public' or 'private' as defined in business logic.

Essential for filtering rapidly between public coupon pools and those only issued by private links or targeted distributions.

access.description:
Optional. Filter by accessLevel—'public' or 'private' as defined in business logic.

Essential for filtering rapidly between public coupon pools and those only issued by private links or targeted distributions.

oneOf.description: Optional. Only include coupons with the exclusive flag set to true/false.

exclusive.description: Optional. Only include coupons with the exclusive flag set to true/false.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Filter coupons by how the discount is calculated, e.g., 'amount' or 'percent'.

Supports admin search tools and analytics on campaign structure.

unit.description:
Optional. Filter coupons by how the discount is calculated, e.g., 'amount' or 'percent'.

Supports admin search tools and analytics on campaign structure.

oneOf.description: Optional. Filter for coupons opened/valid after this UTC timestamp.

opened_at_from.description: Optional. Filter for coupons opened/valid after this UTC timestamp.

oneOf.description: Optional. Filter for coupons opened/valid before this UTC timestamp.

opened_at_to.description: Optional. Filter for coupons opened/valid before this UTC timestamp.

page.description: Current page number to retrieve (for paginated list retrieval).

limit.description: Number of items per page (pagination size); default is system-dependent.

IShoppingCoupon.IRequest.description:
List/search filter type for advanced coupon queries (PATCH operations). Fields defined per 'shopping_coupons' admin GUIs and analytics needs. Supports named, access-level, exclusive-flag, and time-based filtering.

Enables flexible admin/search UI as well as backend systems, supports analytics and reporting of coupon campaigns.

pagination.description: Embedded paging control block, as per IPage.IPagination standard.

data.description: Array of coupon records for the current page, each matching the applied query/filter conditions.

IPageIShoppingCoupon.description:
A paginated result type (implementation of IPage<T>) for lists of coupon records. Contains the current page of coupon objects with a pagination block describing the retrieval context (page number, size, total count, etc.).

Standard pagination used across the shopping mall API for efficient data browsing and UI rendering.

id.description: Unique identifier for the coupon. Maps to the 'shopping_coupons.id' primary key.

shopping_customer_id.description: Reference to the customer (seller or admin) who created this coupon. See 'shopping_coupons.shopping_customer_id'.

actor_type.description:
Enumerated string indicating if creator was an 'administrator' or 'seller'.

Distinguishes context and permissions for coupon creation and tracking.

name.description: User/display name for the coupon, intended for UI and reporting purposes.

access.description: Coupon access mode—'public' or 'private'. Dictates API and UI discoverability in the customer experience.

exclusive.description: If true, coupon can only be used exclusively in each order (cannot stack with others). Reflects 'shopping_coupons.exclusive' field from schema.

unit.description:
Unit for discount—either 'amount' (absolute value) or 'percent' (proportional).

From 'shopping_coupons.unit'.

value.description: Discount amount or percent—as per 'unit'. For 'percent', should be 0~100 inclusive.

oneOf.description: Optional. Minimum order purchase amount required to apply the coupon. 'shopping_coupons.threshold'.

threshold.description: Optional. Minimum order purchase amount required to apply the coupon. 'shopping_coupons.threshold'.

oneOf.description: Optional. Maximum value that this coupon can discount in a single use. Used to cap large order discounts.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum value that this coupon can discount in a single use. Used to cap large order discounts.

multiplicative.description: If true, allows the coupon effect/discount to be multiplied by volume (number of items, when unit=amount).

oneOf.description: Optional. Total number of times this coupon can be issued. Null means unlimited.

volume.description: Optional. Total number of times this coupon can be issued. Null means unlimited.

oneOf.description: Optional. Max number of times per customer/citizen this coupon can be issued (or received).

volume_per_citizen.description: Optional. Max number of times per customer/citizen this coupon can be issued (or received).

oneOf.description: Optional. Number of days after issuance a coupon ticket remains valid (relative expiry).

expired_in.description: Optional. Number of days after issuance a coupon ticket remains valid (relative expiry).

oneOf.description: Optional. Absolute expiry date after which no further tickets are valid, even if issued.

expired_at.description: Optional. Absolute expiry date after which no further tickets are valid, even if issued.

oneOf.description: Timestamp for the first moment the coupon is available (start of validity window).

opened_at.description: Timestamp for the first moment the coupon is available (start of validity window).

oneOf.description: Timestamp for last possible issuance/validity (end of validity window).

closed_at.description: Timestamp for last possible issuance/validity (end of validity window).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon was registered, as per schema.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to coupon configuration, if any.

oneOf.description: If present, coupon has been soft-deleted as per evidence-retention logic. Otherwise null.

deleted_at.description: If present, coupon has been soft-deleted as per evidence-retention logic. Otherwise null.

IShoppingCoupon.description:
A discount coupon metadata record, conforming to 'shopping_coupons' Prisma schema. Contains all configuration and audit fields required to implement advanced campaign logic, eligibility, issuance/usage restrictions, and expiration control.

Critical for marketing campaign analysis, customer loyalty workflows, and compliance reporting.

shopping_customer_id.description:
Required. Reference to the creator's customer record (seller or admin).

Links this coupon to its creating entity for admin/audit traceability and campaign analytics.

actor_type.description: Required. 'administrator' or 'seller'. Explicitly denotes creator's business context and sets constraints on permitted configurations.

name.description: Required. Coupon display name for UI and admin oversight.

access.description: Required. 'public' or 'private'—access mode for discoverability and claim workflow.

exclusive.description: Required. Whether this is an exclusive coupon (cannot be stacked with others in a single order).

value.description: Required. For 'amount', value in currency; for 'percent', value 0~100.

oneOf.description: Optional. Minimum order total for coupon validity.

threshold.description: Optional. Minimum order total for coupon validity.

oneOf.description: Optional. Maximum discount value for a single use. If set, caps discounts for high-value orders.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum discount value for a single use. If set, caps discounts for high-value orders.

multiplicative.description: Required. If true (and unit='amount'), the discount can be multiplied by quantity ordered.

oneOf.description: Optional. Total allowed tickets for this coupon (null means unlimited).

volume.description: Optional. Total allowed tickets for this coupon (null means unlimited).

oneOf.description:
Optional. Tickets per eligible customer/citizen (null means unlimited per customer).

System should check this on ticket claim.

volume_per_citizen.description:
Optional. Tickets per eligible customer/citizen (null means unlimited per customer).

System should check this on ticket claim.

oneOf.description: Optional. Number of days after claim until ticket expires (null means use global/absolute expiry only).

expired_in.description: Optional. Number of days after claim until ticket expires (null means use global/absolute expiry only).

oneOf.description: Optional. Absolute expiration date for all tickets issued under this coupon.

expired_at.description: Optional. Absolute expiration date for all tickets issued under this coupon.

oneOf.description: Optional. Time the coupon becomes available (null means immediately active).

opened_at.description: Optional. Time the coupon becomes available (null means immediately active).

oneOf.description: Optional. Last possible time for ticket issuance/claiming (null means only limited by general expiry or stock).

closed_at.description: Optional. Last possible time for ticket issuance/claiming (null means only limited by general expiry or stock).

IShoppingCoupon.ICreate.description:
POST/create type for registering a new coupon in the mall system. Matches detailed requirements in 'shopping_coupons' for rich campaign configuration, including thresholds, multiplicative effect, and advanced expiration calculus.

Only requires core fields for minimal functioning coupon; optional fields support limiting, advanced expiry, and staged activation.

oneOf.description: Optional. Set or change minimum order value required.

threshold.description: Optional. Set or change minimum order value required.

oneOf.description: Optional. Set or change maximum discount value (absolute cap per use).

limit.description: Optional. Set or change maximum discount value (absolute cap per use).

multiplicative.description: Optional. Change multiplicative rule—for volume-based coupons.

oneOf.description: Optional. Update total ticket volume cap; only possible if no tickets are issued yet.

volume.description: Optional. Update total ticket volume cap; only possible if no tickets are issued yet.

oneOf.description:
Optional. Change per-customer issuance restriction.

Changing may be restricted depending on issued tickets.

volume_per_citizen.description:
Optional. Change per-customer issuance restriction.

Changing may be restricted depending on issued tickets.

oneOf.description: Optional. Update days-until-expire for ticket claims.

expired_in.description: Optional. Update days-until-expire for ticket claims.

oneOf.description: Optional. Update absolute expiration of all tickets.

expired_at.description: Optional. Update absolute expiration of all tickets.

oneOf.description: Optional. Schedule or reschedule start date of coupon validity.

opened_at.description: Optional. Schedule or reschedule start date of coupon validity.

oneOf.description: Optional. Schedule/reschedule cutoff date for ticket issuance.

closed_at.description: Optional. Schedule/reschedule cutoff date for ticket issuance.

deleted_at.description: Set to current time if coupon is being (soft) deleted (admin/owner only).

Accepts changes to all mutable campaign configuration fields, with business rules restricting alteration for coupons that are in use. Certain fields, like unit/value or per-customer limits, may only be changed before any ticket is issued, depending on system policy and campaign state.

Supports nested subtypes for extended filtering. Used in admin screens, campaign configuration, and advanced eligibility logic.

IShoppingCouponCriteria.ICreate.description: POST/creation type for a new coupon applicability criterion in admin tools. Must specify coupon, type, direction, sequence, and optionally section/seller/sale/funnel subtype blobs. Subtypes must match 'type' field. direction.description:
The direction of the application. 'include' or 'exclude' specifies if coupon applies to the target or is excluded from it. Matches Prisma: 'shopping_coupon_criterias.direction'.

Business meaning: controls whitelist/blacklist rules for coupon impact.

sequence.description: Sequence order for this criteria within its coupon. Defines the prioritization of multiple criteria. See Prisma: 'shopping_coupon_criterias.sequence'.

Used to fetch criteria specific to a part of the store or organizational corner.
